sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B download | SourceForge.net
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a compact, open-weight dense multimodal model designed for advanced coding, professional work, research, visual understanding, and long-horizon agentic tasks. Built on the Qwen3.5 architecture, it contains 27B parameters and combines Gated DeltaNet with gated attention across 64 layers.

sources.snippet: Following the widespread community adoption of the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 series, we are pleased to introduce Qwen3.8, the most capable generation in the Qwen open-model family to date.
